facts.fact: Health Minister Mohamed Mahmoud ELY Mahmoud said the electronic medical record would start from Monday 23 February 2026, creating a health file for each patient on the national ID number, as part of the ministry's health reform.

MRT.note: Patient record only; no routine reporting system to the ministry is described.

facts.fact: The Health Minister said, on a visit to the Cheikh Zayed clinic on 21 February 2026, that the hospital had begun taking electronic payment instead of cash.
